span.p:
枚举并打开 COM
115200 8-N-1，先设 DTR/RTS 再 open，观察已有流

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 并行：启动临时算法进程（预热）

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
无合法帧：等预热算法 ready → 写 E1
不等待 ACK，等首个完整 28 字节帧 ≤ 5 s

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
validated：生成 connectionSessionId，adopt 预热算法
接管串口控制（已有流则不重复 E1）

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
验证失败 / 流中断 / 读异常
尽力一次 E0 → 关闭 COM → 3 s 后重连

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
读取 4096 B，按读边界打 received_at_ms
RawChunk 入队（容量 64，50 ms 超时计 gap）

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
ApplicationService.process
校验 connectionSessionId + 来源 serial

span.p:
HeadsetRev181Parser
AA AA AA | 0x1C | 序号 2B | EEG 18B | HR 1B | BB BB BB

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
原始帧持久化 raw.device_frame
序号 4:6 大端；丢包/乱序/重同步统计

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: ParsedSignal：eeg 18 B + hr 1 B

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
SignalWindowAssembler 600 ms
窗口到点刷出，持久化 parsed.signal_batch

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
算法输入映射 → 算法桥进程 A
EEG = 每帧 2B 序号 + 18B；HR = 每帧 1B，限 5 个/秒；2 s 超时

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
WindowResult → EegAlignmentCache
双方均佩戴时用头环最新 EEG ±5% 替换耳机 EEG 类指标

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
持久化 algorithm.result → GatewayApplication A
latestSnapshot / getLatest / 订阅 fanout

WebSocket 600 ms 批量事件
data.source = headset
